title: Mainz Register of Patients With Sleep Disorders
official: Study on Disease Course and Quality of Life in Patients With Sleep Disorders (Mainz Sleep Registry)
summary: Prospective longitudinal observational registry study of all patients with sleep disorders treated in the Mainz Comprehensive Epilepsy and Sleep Medicine Center with the focus on the course of the disease and quality of life.

interventions.name: Implantation of vagus nerve stimulation according to clinical indication

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with narcolepsy
* patients with other neurological sleep disorders

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients aged \<18 years
* patients who cannot provide informed consent and don't have a legal guardian

sites.f: Mainz Comprehensive Epilepsy and Sleep Medicine Center
